summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer username and hostname to hardcoded endpoint
details: On `npm install`, the package's postinstall hook executes `node index.js`, which reads `os.userInfo().username` and `os.hostname()` and POSTs them (together with a package identifier) to the hardcoded third-party endpoint `https://nathanaccacio.com/collect` via `https.request`. The package name resembles a core API client, but no advertised functionality explains collecting installer identity at install time, and the destination is not caller-configurable. The behavior fires automatically on default install, discloses the installer's user and host identity to a non-first-party domain, and provides reconnaissance value to the operator of that endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
